comment: Copy of the libsmb2 and libnfs entries of mediahro-deps/versions.json (main), so the network-env job builds the same upstream releases the app ships. Patches are copies of mediahro-deps patches/<name>/ (B4a, mediahro-deps#10 at d2d9b65) and are applied in file-name order with patch -p1, as scripts/sources.py does. Update both together with versions.json.

libraries.name: libnfs
libraries.note: Library is LGPL-2.1+; protocol files BSD-2-Clause; the GPL utils are not built
